_source: foundational_documents/The_Whole_DOT_spec.txt §2 (execution order) and §3 (constant registry). READ FROM THE SPEC, NOT RETYPED FROM A PROMPT - the spec is the source of truth and every constant there carries a derivation and a status label.
_depth_floor_note: DERIVED, per direction independently. The d2->d3 cliff: LONG 16.55% -> 8.75%, SHORT 12.54% -> 5.40%. Same value both sides because two independent measurements agree, not because a threshold was imposed.
_admission_note: DERIVED. The only buildable rule. CURRENT opened 9,356 trades and deleted them post-hoc; ATOMIC refused 189 valid events for $20,373.
_max_positions_note: SWEPT. 21 is the LAST SAFE VALUE - the margin is ONE SLOT WIDE (§8.1).
_global_gate_note: SWEPT. Raw ATR at the entry bar, not a percentile. A risk dial with no optimum; 20 is the knee.
_tier_note: tier = min(depth, 5). Thresholds are mechanism-D adaptive percentiles at the entry bar. TIER 1 AND TIER 2 ARE NOT CARRIED - they are unreachable under a floor of 3 and the spec states a build must not carry them. SHORT d4/d5+ are FREE by measurement (§5.3), not by inheritance.
_conviction_note: recentfb FALSE is DERIVED - DISABLED ON MEASUREMENT. It sized losers up more than winners (winners 1.256->1.183, losers 1.186->1.094) and removing it takes 20% off the worst bar. master.py L1005 hardcoded it TRUE.
_base_lot_note: §6 is quoted at 1.0 lot base. The adopted live figure is 0.30; scaling is exact because the engine fills at the same price regardless of lot size.

screen._holdout_note: SPEC §2. N was never pinned; one extra training month moves the survivor count 28% (6,267 -> 8,016). Required key.
screen._pctile_note: SPEC §4.5. Percentile of the SURVIVING pool, per direction, AFTER the four absolute criteria. null DISABLES. NEVER set from the incumbent medians - measured on FULL-SAMPLE statistics, one step from the look-ahead the pre-filter had.

gates._stage_a_note: REV5 §5.3 STAGE A IS A POWER FLOOR, NOT A QUALITY GATE. The original asked "is this cell worse than the book?" and SHORT d3 is BETTER (5.21% vs 7.29%), so it closed before any candidate could be tested while Micro_Hurst > p90 demonstrably works there at p=0.000. "Worth gating" is not "worse than average".
gates._stage_d_note: TWO TIERS, NEVER CONFLATED. CONFIRMED needs p < alpha/(shortlist x cells) = 0.05/264 = 0.00019, which 200 draws CANNOT RESOLVE. AN EMPTY CONFIRMED TIER IS THE CORRECT RESULT, NOT A FAILURE. Do not lower a threshold to populate it. THE STAGE ADOPTS NOTHING AUTOMATICALLY.

gates._prereg_note: REV5 §5.4. THE MISSING INFORMATION IS A PRIOR. Hand-derivation cleared p=0.022 and p=0.000 as ONE candidate at ONE cell on a mechanism argument - trial count 1. The same p as best-of-66 is expected ~1.5 times by chance. Declared BEFORE the run, printed in the banner, tested at its own trial count. THE ARTIFACT RECORDS THE CONFIG SHA so a candidate cannot be added after seeing the scan output - without that, pre-registration is just a way to declare a winner.
gates._arch_note: THE S2 POOL CANNOT EXPRESS > p90. dt._D_SPEC is exactly [0.2, 0.8], so pool hi/lo conditions are p80/p20. The 297 signals are built from that vocabulary while the adopted gate stack uses percentiles it cannot express - the gates entered through hand-derivation with swept_thresholds, never through the scan grammar. ARCHITECTURE, not an error. A Micro_Hurst:hi drawn from the pool is > p80, a LOOSER condition, and ranking it is ranking the wrong candidate.
gates._prereg_route_note: REV7: THE PREREG PATH DOES NOT PASS THROUGH STAGE C. It goes straight to the Stage D null ON THE FULL CELL - 20 loss events at SHORT d3 rather than 4 - which is how the gate was derived. Micro_Hurst > p90 FAILS Stage C at SHORT d3 because half A retains 1 loss bar of 35 against a base of 0.0208 ON FOUR LOSS BARS, and the verdict flips on the split definition alone. THAT IS A PROPERTY OF THE HALF, NOT THE GATE.

bands._superseded_note: THE 4,575-POOL / N=2 BANDS ARE SUPERSEDED. Reading an N=1 draw against them produced the WITHDRAWN "four of five arms sit below their band". Re-measured, nothing is below and 297 sits ABOVE.
